title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates htmlwidgets so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7, Hibernate 7). It follows the same approach as the already-merged platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19) and legacyui.

## Changes
- Module version is now 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, `openMRSVersion` is 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and the `openmrs-bom` is imported. `config.xml` now sets `require_version` to 3.0.0.
- Builds with Java 21 (`release 21`, `-parameters`). Surefire is bumped so it can run JUnit Jupiter. The PowerMock exclusions are gone.
- `openmrs-web` moved from the parent pom to the omod. On the api test classpath, core's `WebConfig` (`@EnableWebMvc`) was being picked up and failing the context test with "No ServletContext set".
- `HibernateHtmlWidgetsDAO`:
  - The Criteria / `Expression` / `Order` queries, which Hibernate 7 removed, are now equivalent HQL with the same retired/voided filters and name ordering.
  - It uses `jakarta.persistence.Query` and a typed `NativeQuery<Integer>` in place of the removed `org.hibernate.Query` / `SQLQuery`.
- `javax.servlet(.jsp)` imports are now `jakarta.servlet(.jsp)`.
- commons-lang is now commons-lang3, and `escapeHtml` is now `escapeHtml4`.
- `HtmlWidgetsServiceTest` is migrated to JUnit 5 with core's `org.openmrs.test.jupiter` base class.
- legacyui-omod (provided) moved to 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT.
- CI: release workflow and Bamboo use JDK 21. The JDK 8/11/17 jobs are dropped because they can't build `release 21`.

## Verification
- `mvn clean install` passes.
- I deployed the omod on openmrs-core master (`mvn jetty:run`) together with legacyui 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, calculation 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT and fhir2 6.0.0-SNAPSHOT:
  - All modules started, and the server log has no errors from this module.
  - Logging in through the UI works.
  - `/module/htmlwidgets/demonstration.form` renders.

## Notes for reviewers
- `getPersonNamesById` with a non-empty query references `u.username` without a `User u` in its `from` clause, so Hibernate rejects it. That bug predates this change, and nothing in the omod calls it, so I left it alone.
- The demo page logs a browser-side `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'regional')` from the jQuery UI datepicker localisation. It doesn't affect startup.

title: (docs) Replace the dead Travis badge with the GitHub Actions one
body:
The README badge still points at travis-ci.org, which shut down and now redirects to a 404, so the badge renders blank. This module builds on GitHub Actions via build.yml, so this points the badge and its link there.

Heads up that the badge will show red right now: the latest build.yml run on master failed on 2026-09-03 on the OWASP dependency check job, not the Maven build.

title: Separate OWASP dependency check into its own job
body:
## Summary
- Separate OWASP dependency check into a standalone workflow job
- OWASP check only runs on push and workflow_dispatch (not on PRs)
- Build job no longer runs the OWASP check inline or needs the NVD_API_KEY secret

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify build job still passes
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check runs on push to the default branch
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check does not run on pull requests
